segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, this is Jordan at Northline Supply. I just need a copy of our March invoice and, yeah, if you can confirm the amount that was charged on April 2.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I get your account name and the last four digits of the billing contact phone number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Account is Northline Supply, and the last four are 1842.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great, thank you. I’m pulling that up in the billing tool now. Okay, I see the March invoice, number 43891, for $2,760.00. It was paid by card on April 2.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you send the PDF to billing@northlinesupply.com? That should be on the account.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, I see that address listed as the billing email. I’m sending the invoice PDF now, and you should have it within a minute or two.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it already. That’s all I needed, thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Glad it came through. I’ll note the ticket as completed. Have a good one.
